chapters: Jano' ba' oi'ñga' vaik gu gɨ'kora' gu Joakim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa suudai' u'va gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan do'ñcho gu noobh gu Joakim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa baasɨ'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' cham gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu vaak chumñigam gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Aspenas gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ma'nkam vaak ja'tkam chiñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai' bɨx matda' mamatdagɨm jix bhai' gu ñi'ook tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook nɨɨn gu Kaldeos.
Jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu tanoolh jugi gu gɨ'kora' suudai' u'va i'i; na vaik na ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu Danieel gu Ananiias gu Misael gu Asariias.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' jix dhaas gu Danieel gu Beltsasar; mi' dhɨr gu Ananiias gu Sadrak; jano' ba' gu Misael gu Mesak; gio ba' gu Asariias gu Abed-nego.
Jano' ba' gu Danieel jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi gu gɨ'kora' tu' suudai' u'va i'i; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Jawatan Dios gu Danieel nɨidhidha' jix bhai' aagak bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba'.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Danieel; gio ba' no'ñ choo'n gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' nɨi'ñchudat jugi; na gu' buupui gu vupui gu ñi'ook tuutu'm na ba' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' mo'o.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Danieel gu Melsar ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Danieel gu Ananiias gu Misael gu Asariias.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' soi'ñ tu duukam mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh jugi gu suudai' i'i.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu ñi'ook kua'da' jugi gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bhaan jix duu bɨɨx tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh gu vupui tutkɨ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jugi gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Melsar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi suudai' u'va i'i.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam maakobh gu ñi'ook jix maa gu Jawatan Dios machia' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx; gu' gu Danieel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook tɨɨtki'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook ka't tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Nabukodonosor.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx cham ka't gaagam tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx na ja'p gu Danieel gu Ananiias gu Misael gu Asariias; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam matda' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx mui'kim tutkɨ bɨx nɨi'ñdha' ka't bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Danieel bɨɨx ka'm oi'ñga' maa'n gu gɨ'kora' gu Kiro.
Jano' ba' gook oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Nabukodonosor tɨɨtki' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' tɨɨt nɨi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Kaldeos na ba' gu gɨ'kora' tɨɨtki'; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ tu' maachim.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Kaldeos gu gɨ'kora' nɨɨn gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' na ba' bɨɨx tas jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr tu' tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Kaldeos; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't; mi' dhɨr tu' cham boopoya' gu vaak ka't.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' juana' jix gɨ' nɨidhat; na ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gookim jix duñia' gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' tu' kakasnira' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix maat jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh na jix bhai'; na ba' ja'xñi na ba' tu' gu vaak na jix bhai' jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu Kaldeos tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gui'p; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu chio'ñ bhaan gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu gɨ'kora' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam tu' gu Jawatan tɨtda:―¿Jax nɨidhim tu' jix duñia' tu' gu Kaldeo.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' tu' cham tu'x jai'ch vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na jix bhai' cham bɨɨx gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx daak bɨɨx jix gɨ' jix aa'ñdhix bɨx mamatdagɨm gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mamatdagɨm jix duñia' koi'm; gio ba' tu jiim gu Danieel na ba' kooda'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Danieel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ariok jix nukadham gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' kooda' mamatdagɨm gu Babiloonia.
Ba' jix aa' gu Ariok gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook kuiñcha dhi' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jano' ba' gu Ariok gu Danieel.
Jano' ba' gu Danieel chɨbiapui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' koi gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Danieel gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ananiias gu Misael gu Asariias.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr bhaan dhi' daasak gu Danieel cham bɨɨx mamatdagɨm gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Danieel gu ñi'ook gu tukaa'; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' gu Danieel gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr.
Ba' jix aa' gu Danieel; gio ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm; na gu' matda' gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh na jix bhai' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jix maa matda' mamatdagɨm pui'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaam suudai' gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tukgam gu tasi' jix duñia' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tattat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhai'ñ chɨɨdak matda' gu kavɨk jano' tu'; na gu' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Danieel chɨbiapui gu Ariok gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' kooda' mamatdagɨm gu Babiloonia; gio ba' ka't jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mamatdagɨm gu Babiloonia; jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Ariok gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Danieel vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu chio'ñ bhaan gu Judaa gaagam gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Danieel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Beltsasar; gio ba' tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Danieel vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' daasak gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' mamatdagɨm tu' nɨi'ñdha' tu' jɨ'xdha' gu gɨ'kora'.
Gu' gu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook maachim gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor tu' gu tanoolh; gio ba' mo'o bhaan gu ñi'ook dhi'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim ka't; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' daasak cham matda' tu' ka't bɨx na jix do'ig gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' na jax chu'm; gio ba' dhi' na jax chu'm ka't gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' gɇ'kamtu'nda' ka't gu bhóogɨt ka't tɨɨt vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mo'o dhi' na jax chu'm ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai; gio ba' jix toja jodai; mi' dhɨr vook gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' tɨɨt baasɨ'n jix kavɨk jodai baasɨ'n bhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' tɨɨgɨk bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bɨɨx gu novɨ naaka'n na jax chu'm tɨɨt jix kavɨk jodai bhi'ñ jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gio jix duñia' jix kavɨk jodai bhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam jix toja jodai jix uam jodai na ja'p; gio ba' jix búup gu jɨvɨl cham pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook pai'; gu' gu jodai naaka'n na jax chu'm ka't gu kavɨk bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gio gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr tu' jix maa oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bɨxchu'x gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax yooxi' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr tu' dhagia' gu novɨ tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx; gio ba' tu' mii' dhɨr mo'o jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix ali' tu'; gio ba' vaik oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu jodai' na jix uam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' maakobh ka't jix kavɨk na ja'p jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' na ja'p jix kavɨk jodai jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu'x na ja'p jix kavɨk jodai bɨx dhi' tu'x jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' tɨɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n bhi'ñ baasɨ'n jix kavɨk jodai oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't; gu' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk jix kavɨk jodai bhaan jix duñia' jix kavɨk jodai jɨ'kchi bɨɨx bhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt baasɨ'n jix kavɨk jodai baasɨ'n bhi'ñ baasɨ'n ka't oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix kavɨk baasɨ'n ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr jix duñia' jix kavɨk jodai jɨ'kchi bɨɨx bhi'ñ bɨɨx gu kai' gu' cham jix duñia' maa'n bɨɨx na ja'p jix kavɨk jodai cham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' cham pai' dhuuk mɨɨjidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ja'tkam dhi' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu kavɨk ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai cham bɨɨx gu noobh jix duñia' jix kavɨk jodai gu jodai' na jix uam jix toja jodai jix uam jodai; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu gɨ'kora' tu'; mi' dhɨr jir bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vupui gu Danieel jix aa'ñdhix maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Danieel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dhi' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Danieel jix maa mui'x juana' jix dhaas gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' bɨx oidha' gɨ' gu Babiloonia gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' bhaan bɨx mamatdagɨm gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' gu Danieel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas bhaan oidha' gɨ' gu Babiloonia gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego; gio ba' gu Danieel ka't ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor dhi' jix uam jodai jix duñia' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix búup yooxi' gu Dura oidha' gɨ' gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' oidha' gɨ' na ba' dhi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor ka't jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' oidha' gɨ' dhi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' mi'p tɨɨt vupui bhaan dhi' ka't jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam ñiiñio'k.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' jix uam jodai gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' no'x cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tas ka't baas gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨiñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam ñiiñio'k gu ñi'ook o'lhia dhi' jix uam jodai gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook dhɨt gu chio'ñ gu Kaldeos gu Judiios.
Jano' ba' a'gi'ñchu' bham gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' na ba' bɨɨx tas jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga bɨx gu chio'ñ tɨiñ gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook dhi' jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jum duu baas gu ñi'ook gu tai.

Jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch gu chio'ñ gu Judiios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan oidha' gɨ' gu Babiloonia; gio ba' gu Mesak gu Abed-nego; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu'; jano' ba' cham gu Jawatan Dios cham dhi' jix uam jodai tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Nabukodonosor bɨɨx daak bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu dhi' ja'tkam gu chio'ñ vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Nabukodonosor; gio ba' tu'r gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhi' jix uam jodai jix duñia'.
Na gu' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tɨiñ gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook na gu' tu' cham gu tas boopoya' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't mii' dhɨr namkidhat gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego tu ñi'ook gui'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook bhaan dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios nɨidhat jɨ'xdha' gu tai; gio ba' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' nɨidhat dhi' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Nabukodonosor ka't jix bhuup daak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui bhaan gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego; gio ba' tu ñi'ook kɨɨv mui'kim jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' na jix uam ga'ra' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu chio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jajannulhi'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix jai' mɨmɨim gu tai jix duñia' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaik gu chio'ñ gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego ia'rɨ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix búup jix duñia'; gio ba' cham vaik gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tai tu ñi'ook gui'p gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr tu'r gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' maakobh gu chio'ñ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai gu tanoolh na jix bhai' cham tu'x jai'ch; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' maakobh nɨidhim gu mar gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Nabukodonosor gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai; gio ba' gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego tu duukam jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego moor tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' na ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu chio'ñ na ja'p gu tai cham gu chuukug tu' ɨɨbhidham ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu tai ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego bhañ nobii'ñ tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' kapbhai' gu chuukug va'k tu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam nɨɨn tu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego ka't gu vaak ka't jix duñia'; na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook na ja'p.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sadrak gu Mesak gu Abed-nego oidha' gɨ' gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ja'tkam ñiiñio'k gu ñi'ook bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' buimɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buimɨk kɨɨ'p oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' aapi' bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Nabukodonosor ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu' bɨx mamatdagɨm gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs nɨi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kaldeos; gio ba' tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu' cham pai' dhuuk.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbiapui vupui bhaan tu' gu Danieel gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Beltsasar na ja'p gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨgi'ñdham tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan bham.

Jano' ba' gu Beltsasar gɨ'kora' ja'tkam nɨi'ñdha' tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n cham tu'x jai'ch tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨgi'ñdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daasak tu' buupui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu u'u tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' jix duñia' ka't jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gɨ'lhidha' dhi' gu u'u jix duñia' jix kavɨk jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr ñiata bɨɨx ka'm bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' vaaso ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'bhɨ na ba' bɨx ka't jugi; gio ba' bɨtaa'n ɨkgiga'n gu vaakax yooxi' mamraga'n gu vaak na jix bhai' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr bɨx gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o jix bhaan tɨmñim gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨtda; gio ba' gu u'u mamraga'n vaaso gu i'bhɨ; mi' dhɨr gu vaakax bɨtaa'n gu u'uvhig mamraga'n.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk jodai gu jodai' na jix uam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaas yooxi'; gio ba' ka't bɨɨx gu tɨkɨr baasɨ'n bɨɨx gu vaakax gu vaas gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu chio'ñ jix maa gu i'ii'ñ gu vaakax bhaan kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook jɨɨgi'ñdham; na ba' na jix do'ig gu Altiisimo oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu chichio'ñ jix maa bhaan gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor buupui dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tu' gu Beltsasar daipu' na gu' bɨx mamatdagɨm oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' cham pai' dhuuk; na gu' gu' tu' no'p na gu' cham tu'x jai'ch tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨgi'ñdham.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Danieel gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Beltsasar juruuñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tas; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Beltsasar tu' cham tu'; jano' ba' jix aa' gu Beltsasar; gio ba' gu Jawatan ka't na ba' cham bhai' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu u'u jix duñia' gɨ'lhidha' jix duñia' jix kavɨk jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr ñiata bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' vaaso ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'bhɨ na ba' bɨx ka't jugi; gio ba' bɨtaa'n gu vaakax yooxi' mamraga'n oi'ñka' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' tu' jix kavɨk tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr aapi' bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ñi' gu gɨ'kora' jix bhaan tɨmñim gu tɨkɨr chɨtda; gio ba' gu u'u; gu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk jodai gu jodai' na jix uam gu vaas yooxi'; jano' ba' ka't bɨɨx gu tɨkɨr baasɨ'n ka't bɨɨx gu vaakax yooxi' bɨɨx ka'm bhaan kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Altiisimo tu' tɨbiap bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan.

Na tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx gu vaakax yooxi' ka't gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx gu vaas yooxi' tu' na ja'p gu vaakax bɨɨx gu tɨkɨr ka'; gio ba' kɨɨv bhaan tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu Altiisimo oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu chichio'ñ maa'n.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu u'u oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' tu' gu ñi'ook aapi' gu tɨkɨr.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' uañi'ñ bɨɨx bɨx bhai' tu' na cham jir bhai' bɨɨx i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam na ba' bɨɨx bia'; na jix duñia' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam masaa'n bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Babiloonia tu' na ba' gu vaak oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu kavɨk na ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda'.

Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ñi'ook gu chin gu gɨ'kora' na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor; mi' dhɨr oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu vaakax yooxi' ka't gu vaak na jix bhai' na ja'p gu vaakax tu'; gio ba' kɨɨv bhaan tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu Altiisimo oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu chichio'ñ jix maa.
Jano' ba' gu tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Nabukodonosor ka't baas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' gu vaas na ja'p gu vaakax gu chuukug bɨɨx gu tɨkɨr bɨɨx ka'm na ja'p gu u'uvhig.

Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu Nabukodonosor gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu tɨkɨr jix duñia' ka't; gio ba' gu Altiisimo tas na jix gɨ' jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx tas; na gu' aapi' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bɨx.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'; gio ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' bhaan aagak; mi' dhɨr tu' cham tu'x jai'ch dhi' gu novɨ; jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' suulh tu' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'; gio ba' jix duñia' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix gɨ' ka't.
Na gu' jano' tu' gu Nabukodonosor bhai'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tas na jix gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨkɨr na gu' bɨx buimɨi tu'r gu bhóogɨt ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' jɨ'xdha' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu Belsasar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx gɨ' chiñia' mambhɨɨx gɨ' suudai' u'va.

Jano' ba' gu Belsasar bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va jix aa'ñdhix jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu Nabukodonosor gu taat ka't vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jerusalem; na ba' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai gu u'u gu jodai.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tas moor gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan mɨichdhai bhaan vaak ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam kɨkbok bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñdha' gu Kaldeos; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' jix aa' mamatdagɨm gu Babiloonia; mi' dhɨr no'x gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' dhi' gu'p ka't tɨi'chu' ñakaabma' jix uam jodai baakux; jano' ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' vaik.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx mamatdagɨm gu gɨ'kora' cham gu'p tu' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Belsasar ka't gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jix duñia' chiñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' chɨbiapui; gio ba' tu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' na ba' bɨɨx tas jix duñia' cham tu' jix uam.

Jano' ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' cham tu'x jai'ch gu chio'ñ jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨgi'ñdham; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu taat gu ñi'ook gu tasi' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam matda' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor gu taat gu gɨ'kora' gu taat gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan bɨx nɨi'ñdha' gu Kaldeos.

Na gu' na gu' ka't gaagam jix gɨ' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tɨɨtki' tu ñi'ook maachim gu Danieel; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Beltsasar; mi' dhɨr jano' gu Danieel jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Danieel ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' jix aa' gu Danieel; mi' dhɨr tu' mii' dhɨr gu Danieel gu ma'nkam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Judaa gu taat gu Judea.
Jano' ba' tu' naak tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨgi'ñdham tu' gu ñi'ook gu tasi' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' matda'.
Jano' ba' jano' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' mamatdagɨm gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' dhi' gu'p; gu' cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' naak tu' no'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kookoxdha'; gio ba' tu' jano' dhi' gu'p jix duñia' ka' tɨi'chu' ñakaabma' jix uam jodai baakux oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka' vaik gu Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Danieel vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' juana' ka't na ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu'p tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' jix maa gu Nabukodonosor gu taat oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' nɨidhat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa bɨx gu ja'tkam ñiiñio'k gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan; na jix duñia' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu suudai' ka't atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan gɇ'kamtu'nda'.

Jano' ba' ka't baas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu vaakax bɨɨx buur gu kakkavɨk ka't gu vaak na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu vaas jix duu jugi na ja'p gu vaakax gu chuukug ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu tɨkɨr bɨɨx ka'm gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu chichio'ñ bhaan.
Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu Belsasar cham jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ pu'ñir bɨx dhi'.

Jano' ba' va'k bhaan gu Jawatan gu tɨkɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu' gu vaak tu' chiñia' gu u'vɨ suudai' u'va; gio ba' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai gu u'u gu jodai tu' chɨɨdak bhai' ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu oidha' bɨx gu bhóogɨt cham pai' dhuuk nɨidhat.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu novɨ dhi' gu'p.
Jano' ba' gu'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Mene gu Tekel gu Uparsin.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Mene; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Tekel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gaagam.
Jano' ba' gu Peres; gio ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa gu Medos gu Persas.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Belsasar gu Danieel ñakaabma' baakux ka't gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai jum duu vaik gu Jawatan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tukaa' ka't jix koi gu Belsasar gu gɨ'kora' gu Kaldeos.
Jano' ba' gu Dariio gu Media jix bhɨɨ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam gu Dariio bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' chamaam gu ñi'ook gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Na gu' bhaan vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Danieel ka't maa'n dhi' ja'tkam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' jix duñia' na gu' gu gɨ'kora' cham gu tanoolh na jix bhai'.

Na gu' gu' gu Danieel ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim dhi' ja'tkam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' bhaan bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Danieel baasɨ'n oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; na gu' gu' cham gu ñi'ook bua' uañi'ñ na gu' ka't tu' uañi'ñ ka't gaagam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gui'p mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' cham bakia' bhaan dhi' gu Danieel bua' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham bakia' bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jum daa'ñ vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gui'p; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio na ba' bɨɨx tas jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' o'rosiiris gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' jix duñia' vaak ja'tkam jir bɨx bhai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim no'x gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' ka't baas.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bɨx bhai' gu'p na ba' cham jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Media gu Persia cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio gu'p gu ñi'ook.

Na pai' dhuuk gu Danieel na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu'p ka't chɨbiapui gu vaak gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim mi'p bhaan gu Jerusalem kɨkbok vaik mui'kim gu tanoolh vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p va'k.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jum daa'ñ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Danieel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' cham tu jiim jir bɨx bhai' no'x taan gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' jum duu baas jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr tu'r jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Media gu Persia cham.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gui'p vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Danieel gu ma'nkam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Judiios cham tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr va'k vaik mui'kim gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jano' ba' tɨiñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Danieel jix dhaas gu ñi'ook na ba' u'ua'tɨda'; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu tas na ba' u'ua'tɨda'.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jum daa'ñ mia'n gu gɨ'kora' gui'p gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Media gu Persia tu' jir bɨx bhai' gu gɨ'kora' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'ñdhix aichdhak gu Danieel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' a'gi'ñchu' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa' gu Danieel; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' namkidhat.
Na gu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai jix duñia' bhaan ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx chiñia' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Danieel cham.
Jano' ba' ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' jix bɨɨx duu vupui bhaan ka't.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix búup gu bhóogɨt gu xibh ka't jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jimɨɨk mia'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jup tɨɨt jiiñak gu Danieel bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' a'gi'ñchu' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa' gu Danieel; mi' dhɨr gu Danieel tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig gu Jawatan Dios tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Danieel bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' na ba' bɨɨx tas jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhañ nobii'ñ gu chin na ba' cham cham bhai'; na gu' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' bɨx bhai'; mi' dhɨr vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' tu' cham gu ñi'ook cham.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' kuiñcha jix aa'ñdhix gu Danieel; na gu' ka't gu Danieel jix buusñi matgɨm gu ñi'ook na gu' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' jix bɨɨx duu mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu Danieel jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu u'vɨ; na pai' dhuuk cham gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk bɨx o'oo.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio ua'na bɨx gu ja'tkam ñiiñio'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ ka't jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jir bɨx bhai' bɨx aapi' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu Danieel; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix duñia' cham ka't aapi' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Na dodhia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buimɨk kɨɨ'p gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Danieel.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu Danieel ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio gu gɨ'kora' gu Kiro gu Persa.
Jano' ba' maa'n oidha' tas gu Belsasar gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia jix ñi' gu Danieel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ua'na cham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Danieel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu tukaa' maakobh jɨbɨɨlh gu tɨkɨr gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' maakobh gu vaakax gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na ja'p maavɨt ga'ra' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' tu' ka't tɨɨgɨk bɨɨx ka'm jix bɨɨx duu ka't gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas bhaan tɨɨt gu chio'ñ ka't jix maa gu i'ii'ñ gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gookim gu vaakax nɨidhim jix dhaas gu ñi'ook ga'ra' gu chin vaik tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bamii' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨidhim ga'ra' maakobh gu u'uvhig; gio ba' ga'ra' gio dhi' gu vaakax maakobh ɨɨbhidham; mi' dhɨr ka't tajaañ.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tukaa' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' jix kavɨk; gio ba' ga'ra' gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk jodai; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bɨɨx tɨɨt; jano' ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu vaakax jix duñia' va'k ga'ra' mambhɨɨx a'aa'.
Jano' ba' kua' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'aa' jix ali' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan jix bɨɨx duu vaik a'aa' dharka'; gio ba' dhi' ka't gu vupui na ja'p gu vupui gu chio'ñ gu chin ua'rgidhimɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨgɨk bɨɨx ka'm jix bɨɨx duu a'toxkar; gio ba' gu Ankiano jix gɨ' jix daa tɨi'chu' ka't jix toja na ja'p jabook mo'o na ja'p; mi' dhɨr mɨmɨim gu tai.
Jano' ba' gɨ' suudai' jiim gu tai gu tanoolh na jix bhai' busaak vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu Jues jix daa gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha gu ñi'ook ua'rgidhimɨk; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' gu vaakax gu chuukug ka't dhagia' na ba' gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu vaakax aapi' ka't jix duñia' gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm tɨɨda' gu tanoolh na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu tukaa' tɨbaa'ñ gu tɨkɨr na ja'p gu mar gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu Ankiano jix gɨ' tu' jix duu gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' ka't jix maa aapi' gɇ'kamtu'nda' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam ñiiñio'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr aapi' cham ka't oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' cham.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Danieel tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug mo'o.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n tu ñi'ook tu'r gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook tu'x.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu vaakax maakobh gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jɨɨgi'ñdham gu Altiisimo jix duñia' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook maachim tu'r gu ñi'ook gu vaakax gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bɨx ga'ra' gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk jodai gu jodai' na jix uam jix duñia' bɨɨx tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx a'aa' ga'ra' mo'o ka't jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' vaik; gio ba' dhi' ga'ra' gu vupui gu chin ua'rgidhimɨk jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhi' jix duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan jɨɨgi'ñdham.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va gu Ankiano jix gɨ' jix maa ñi'ook na jir bhai' jɨɨgi'ñdham gu Altiisimo; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook jɨɨgi'ñdham oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax ka't maakobh oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx a'aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook ka't jix gɨ' dharka' vaik gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Altiisimo jɨɨgi'ñdham gu Altiisimo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh na jix bhai' ñi'ook na tu a'ga; gio ba' kapbhai' ka't gu novɨ bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam aapi' na ba' ka't gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' aapi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨtaa'n bɨx gu tɨkɨr ka't jix maa gu ja'tkam jɨɨgi'ñdham gu Altiisimo; gio ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bɨx aapi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' gu Danieel jix jai' gu vupui; gu' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' vaik gu gɨ'kora' gu Belsasar jix ñi'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' gu Danieel mi' dhɨr mii' dhɨr ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam va'k.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu ñi'ook ka't na pai' dhuuk tu' ka't gu Susaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' oidha' gɨ' gu Persia; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook kua' ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Ulai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu ñi'ook ka't vupui bhaan gɨ' suudai' jiim ga'ra' gook a'aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' maa'n ka't jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr jix bhai'x jix tɨ'ɨ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx a'aa' gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ matgɨm gu vaakax gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu' ka't gu novɨ; gio ba' jix duñia' jurtu'nka' aagak.
Jano' ba' kua' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ chiiw baasɨ'n bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu oidha' cham gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gio ba' ga'ra' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ chiiw tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook ga'ra' gook a'aa' ka't tu' buupui ka't vupui bhaan gɨ' suudai' jiim dai'bus bhaan bɨɨx daak gu kavɨk.

Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook jix búup bhaan tu' naaka'n jix duñia' gook a'aa' na gu' gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr tu' ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ chiiw; gio ba' kua' jix gɨ' gu kavɨk mii' dhɨr ka't pai' jix tɨ'ɨ maakobh gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan maakobh jɨbɨɨlh gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' maa'n jix buus gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ali' jix jai' saagi'ñ tas buusñi bhaan gu oidha' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' baasɨ'n ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu si'avag gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jix bhai' gu maa'nkar pai' xidhuu ka't baas gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't dhagia' kuiñcha gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu maa'nkar; gio ba' jix duñia' gu oidha' tu'r tu' jix duu.

Jano' ba' tu' jix bhaan ua'rgidhimɨk; gio ba' jɨɨgi'ñdham jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'rgidhimɨk; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm duuk gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' gu maa'nkar jix duñia' xidhuu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gook jix bhai'x vaik gu tanoolh gu xumai gu xibh; mi' dhɨr xidhuu ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kua' tu' gu Danieel gu ñi'ook na ja'p na jax chu'm gu chio'ñ jix dhaas vupui bhaan tu'.
Ba' jix aa' tu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ulai; gio ba' gu Gabriel gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va mia'n pai' tu' ka't; gio ba' bɨɨx namkia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vupui; gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix aa'; na gu' gu mar gu chio'ñ na gu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' kua' a'gi'ñchu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duu gu ñi'ook tɨɨt.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook daak; na gu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ga'ra' a'aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Media gu Persia.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu gɨ'kora' gu Jabaan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' ga'ra' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' maa'n.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh pai' maakobh gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam gu' cham gu kavɨk.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suulhgia' na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' jix bhai'x gu vupui gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu' cham bɨɨx gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk gu ja'tkam jɨɨgi'ñdham.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam iatda' gu novɨ; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook mui'x; mi' dhɨr bhaan gu ñi'ook chiñia'; gu' cham gu novɨ ka't jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu xumai gu xibh tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tu' jix nukadham gu ñi'ook na gu' na ba' mui'x gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Danieel jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka'ook dhɨt gu tanoolh; na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora'; gu' ka't gu ñi'ook cham ka't.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' maa'n gu Dariio gu mar gu Assuero gu ja'tkam gu Medos ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Kaldeos.
Ba' jix aa' oi'ñga' maa'n gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu Danieel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam o'dam ñi'ook jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jeremiiyas ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios soi'm soi'ñ maatai.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix gɨ' suuska'n gu ñi'ook nuuka'n ñi'ook na jix bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai'.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tɨɨgɨ' tu ñi'ook gɇ'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñdha' gu gɨ'kora' gɇ'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñdha' chiñia' gɇ'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñdha' tattat bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan bɨx bhai' gu jodai' na jix uam gu vupui na ja'p gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Judaa gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem bɨx gu Israeel mia'n bɨx oi'ñga'n pai' baas kuiñcha uañi'ñ bɨɨx bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam gu vupui gɇ'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñdha' gu gɨ'kora' gɇ'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñdha' chiñia' gɇ'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñdha' tattat; na gu' bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios mambhɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch uañchuda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jiim ñi'ook na tu a'ga jix dhaas vupui bhaan no'ch gu novɨ tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' cham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' bhaan no'ch mu'ai gu ñi'ook ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan no'ch bhaan gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' jix duñia' bhaan no'ch gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' cham bhai'; na cham pai' dhuuk ka't gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' bhaan ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' suudai' u'va bhaan no'ch; gio ba' cham gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu Dios tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ñi'ook tu'r.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan cham bhai' bhaan no'ch; na gu' jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx buimɨi jix duu na gu' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' jix buusñi gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' dhi' gu tanoolh; gio ba' uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan bhaan bɨx bɨx bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' daak i'iich bhaan kiicham gu Jerusalem jix bhaan gu kavɨk; na gu' kuiñcha uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' uañi'ñ tattat gu Jerusalem gu ja'tkam gɨ' vaak ja'tkam bɨx chulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam soi'm tu duukam gu vupui jix duñia' bhaan xidhuu gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Jawatan.

Jano' ba' gu Inklina gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak; gio ba' gu vupui bɨx bhai' kiicham bhaan tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ'; na gu' cham bɨx bhai' vupui bhaan bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook mumua'da'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr naak gu Jawatan gu vupui; jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook xoi'kam tu' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu tɨɨgɨ' tɨɨgim bhaan kiicham bhaan gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't a'gi'ñchu' tɨtdada' uañi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel soi'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't a'gi'ñchu' soi'm mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Gabriel ka't buupui gu ñi'ook gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tas gu maa'nkar gu xumai.
Ba' jix aa' jix duu jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Danieel jano' gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia'.
Na gu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix buus gu ñi'ook tu' tɨbiap na ba' na gu' tu' gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Setenta gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ja'tkam bhaan abhaar kiicham na ba' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan tu jiim jix bhaan jɨɨgi'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem bɨɨx ka'm gu Mesiias gu Priinkipe kɨɨv gu ñi'ook gook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ɨrban vaak jodai gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Mesiias cham; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gɨ'kora' ja'tkam tu' jix ai gu ñi'ook kiicham xidhuu; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka't gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' kia'pɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan mui'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ kia'pɨx gu maa'nkar; gio ba' mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka't dhi' bɨɨx ka'm bɨx; mi' dhɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' bhaan gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' vaik oi'ñga' gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Danieel gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Beltsasar; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu' gu ñi'ook ka't jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh tu' gu Danieel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vaik.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui' jix bhai'x tu' chɨbiapui gu chuukug tu' suudai' u'va gu chin tu' bɨɨx choi' bɨɨx ka'm vaik gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook maakobh gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n ka't tu' jugii'ñ gɨ' suudai' jiim gu iddekel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu chio'ñ tɨi'chu' bhiibgich gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai gu Upas.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug ka't na ja'p gu jodai gu Tarsis gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tai tɨɨt na ja'p jix uam gu jodai' na jix uam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Danieel tu' mii' dhɨr gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' cham gu chichio'ñ mi'p; gu' gu ñi'ook bhaan choo'n jiboi'ññor gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhi' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' cham gu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' va'k gu kavɨk cham oi'ñdha'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tɨiñ gu ñi'ook ka't tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu ñi'ook tu' bhaan kɨkbok bhaan gu ñi'ook gu noobh.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Danieel gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook bamii' bhaan tɨɨt; na gu' tu' jix duñia' jano'; jano' ba' kua' a'gi'ñchu' dhi' tu' ka't gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Danieel cham jum i'obh; na gu' dɨr maa'n gu tanoolh chɨɨdak gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' kuiñcha gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' tɨbiap.

Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Persia jix dhaas bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu Miguel maa'n gu ñi'ook chiñia' suudai' u'va na ba' tu' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tɨbiap na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim tu' jix ai gu ja'tkam gu tanoolh; na gu' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' kua' a'gi'ñchu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuutu'm gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu oidha'.

Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p na jax chu'm gu mar gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' ba' gu chin tu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr ka't vupui bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan bɨɨx gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' bhaan tu' cham gu kavɨk.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu Jawatan ñiokda' bɨɨx dhi' gu Jawatan na gu' gu kavɨk cham tu' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr na ja'p na jax chu'm gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jum i'obh; mi' dhɨr bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu'; jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' a'gi'ñchu' tu' tu ñi'ook; na gu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan na gu'.
Ba' jix aa'; na gu' ñɨidhat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tɨbiap tu' na gu' no'ñ gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Persas; mi' dhɨr gamai' tu' jupaabkamu'n gu ñi'ook gu Grekia.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'nak gu'p tu'r; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch dhi' tu'x gu ñi'ook gu Miguel gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' maa'n gu Dariio gu Media tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' tu' gu ñi'ook tu'r; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia maakobh namkɨm bɨx; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx namkɨm jix duñia' bɨx bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Jabaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' jix kavɨk bhaan gu gɨ'kora' aagak.

Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix bhai'x oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' maakobh jɨbɨɨlh gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' cham tu' bhaan aapi' bɨɨx; na gu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' mai' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix maat jix kavɨk gu gɨ'kora' saagi'ñ; gu' maa'n chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr aapi' ka't jix gɨ' aapi'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar u'vɨ gu gɨ'kora' saagi'ñ ɨlhdham gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook; gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook; na gu' ka't kapbhai' gu mar mi'p baasɨ'n mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n bhaan ɨlhdham bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu kavɨk gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx chiñia' bɨɨx jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu Ejipto; gio ba' bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu gɨ'kora' saagi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook chugi'ñ; gio ba' ɨlhdham tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx daak bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' saagi'ñ bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' yooxi' bɨx mii' dhɨr ka't kapbhai' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ mui'x; gu' cham.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' jix gɨ' maa'n gu ñi'ook ɨlhdham bɨɨx jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx mumua'da' namkɨm.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu ñi'ook mui'x bhaan gu gɨ'kora' saagi'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook na ba' ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook kiicham jix kavɨk; gio ba' saagi'ñ cham tu' gu ja'tkam tu' gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam aagak tu' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui na ba' jix ai bɨɨx bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨɨx tu'x gu ñi'ook maa'n mar u'vɨ gu u'vɨ na ba' bhaan; gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' ka't.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mumua'da'; gu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; gu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim cham.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu ñi'ook gɇ'kamtu'nda' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gu' gu tanoolh ka't jix bhai'x cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' cham nɨidhat oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba' ɨlhdham cham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bhai'x i'ii'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't vupui bhaan ka't; gio ba' gio gɨ'kora' ja'tkam ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx iatda' jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' kua' oidha' gɨ' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duu tattat tu' tattat; gio ba' namkɨm sandaarui'x; mi' dhɨr bhaan; jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ bhaan gu gɨ'kora' saagi'ñ bɨɨx jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' saagi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; na gu' gu' cham na gu' jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi gu takarui' jix duñia'; gio ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't mui'x koko'kam.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ dhi' ja'tkam gook gu gɨ'kora' ka't na ba' gu masad cham bhai' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu' cham cham tu' na gu' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix maat gu oidha' bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ ka't bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix bhaan; gio ba' jix maat gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam saagi'ñ; gu' cham ka't namkia' na ja'p.
Na gu' na gu' aajim bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kîttim gu ñi'ook bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix bhaan; gio ba' jix maat jix bhai'x jix bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n; gio ba' xidhuu gu kavɨk gu vaak na jix bhai' gu maa'nkar jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan; gu' gu ja'tkam jix maati' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' mamatdagɨm gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam matda' mui'x; gio ba' gu tai gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix ali'; gio ba' mui'x bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' dhɨt mamatdagɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh na jix bhai'; na gu' na ba' dhi' cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam aagak; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook kɨɨ'p ka't bɨɨx ka'm ka't daak; na gu'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tattat cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' xoi'kam gu u'vɨ; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios oi'ñdha' na gu' bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu Mausim gu Jawatan Dios tattat cham jix maati'; gio ba' nɨidhat bɨɨx jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu jodai a'bhar bɨɨx tu'x u'uuk.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mausim gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' jix maat bhaan mui'x gu oidha'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' saagi'ñ bɨɨx; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook bhaan na ja'p bɨɨx gu ja'tkam kavaayo mui'x; mi' dhɨr oi'ñga'n tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu oidha' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim mumua'da' oidha' gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr gu Edom gu Moab maa'n gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu novɨ oi'ñga'n cham gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam jix uam jodai jix toja jodai bɨx tu'x a'bhar gu Ejipto gu Libia gu Etiopiia pai'.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tas buusñi gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx jix gɨ' daak na ba' cham tu' duu kooda' mui'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook vaak zel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' gu kavɨk gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim xidhuu; gio ba' ɨlhdham bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Miguel gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook cham pai' dhuuk ka't mi' dhɨr ka't gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm jano' ba'; gu' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu ja'tkam bɨx bakia' u'uan.
Jano' ba' mui'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo' gu oidha' ka't na ba' gu oidha' baidhika' na ba' xi'ɨraam gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' pui'm gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' bɨx bhai' na ja'p gu si'avag gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Danieel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook u'uan bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mui'x.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Danieel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook mi'p maa'n dhi' baasɨ'n jugii'ñ gɨ' suudai' jiim baasɨ'n jugii'ñ gɨ' suudai' jiim.
Ba' jix aa' maa'n gu chio'ñ tɨi'chu' bhiibgich ka't bhaan gu suudai' gɨ' suudai' jiim; gio ba' duuk ka't gu ñi'ook dhi' kɨɨ'p.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ tɨi'chu' bhiibgich ka't bhaan gu suudai' gɨ' suudai' jiim kɨɨ'n gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook na jix do'ig ka't gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jix bhaan bɨx dhi' tu'x ka't.
Jano' ba' tu' gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook ka't dhi' tu'x.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jiim gu Danieel dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mui'x ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' jix bhai'x jix duñia' gu' jix duñia' pui'm.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu ñi'ook ua'tulhi'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jix bhai' gu maa'nkar bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm jix bhai'x vaik gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.
